No — the race condition's still a race condition regardless of the clock. Deadline changes how fast we fix it, not whether we do.

If you've got an actual reason it doesn't hit in practice — some invariant upstream that prevents the interleaving I flagged — tell me what it is and I'll look at it. But "basically fine" isn't that; it's the same shape as the claim I was checking when I found it.

Faster paths that don't involve shipping it broken: a quick lock/guard around the specific window, or ship behind a flag if the worker path isn't in the hot loop for whatever's landing in an hour. Either of those I can turn around fast. Straight approval on the diff as it stands, no.
